sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW acquisition: with actual Animal Handling proficiency, select one already real willing/tamed Beast, noncorrupted, INT<7, that fits one of the three finite body templates below. Finding, buying or taming it requires actual campaign access/consent; the feat creates no animal, stocked shop or universal charm. Spend one uninterrupted hour together at touch range; one bond attempt per completedLR, noRP. One feat bond at a time. Use the template corresponding to the real animal's body/native movement; do not turn a dog into a bird or grant a new breathing mode. AC12+floor(ownerPB/2), maximumHP5+total owner level; template attack/ability/movement values are explicit NEW. At initial bond convert existing HP proportionally max(1,floor(newMax×oldHP/oldMax)); preserve actual conditions/injuries. Later maximum growth never heals, decreases clamp without damage. Ordinary legal healing works, but no Hit Dice/rest-refill is invented. Use one shared BA command within60ft while the animal can perceive you: in its attached phase after your regular turn, move and make its one attack or Dash/Disengage/Help/Dodge. No independent turn/Reaction; uncommanded move defensively and Dodge. The animal's HP-only chassis dies at0, producing its one actual corpse and ending the bond, with no Wound/death-save sequence; this is a feat-specific NEW rule, not generic animal law. Death/release never creates replacement: after a new completedLR, a new real animal and full hour are required. Voluntary release takes one uninterrupted hour and ends the bond without healing; preserve the same physical animal and restore its prior ordinary profile with the same current-HP fraction, not a fresh full animal. A creature cannot have this and a Ranger bond simultaneously; transferring requires actual release and new paid acquisition, not additive statistics. Owner death ends the bond and, if the animal remains alive, restores its saved ordinary profile using the same positive-HP ratio conversion as release; a dead animal remains its actual corpse. Temporary owner incapacity prevents new commands but does not cancel a previously committed legal command; after that command, uncommanded phases remain defensive. This never supplies autonomous attacks.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Complete real-animal bond, three body templates, finite statistics, proportional conversion, command/HP-only death and no-free-replacement procedure.

At0HP it dies and leaves its actual body. Taking a rest alone neither revives it nor creates another beast.

NEW ACQ-05 purchase/bond distinction: acquire Animal Companion once by committing one actual earned unspent feat opportunity while meeting its actual Animal Handling proficiency prerequisite and all other acquisition gates. Record that paid grant and its acquisition snapshot atomically. The animal and bonding hour are not conditions of purchasing the feat. Ownership begins at that commitment, with no companion and one unspent bond attempt under FS-06; it grants neither an animal nor an earlier completed Long Rest. Animal identity, matching template and any actually sourced sense choice belong to each bond record, not a permanently locked feat-purchase choice. The retained nonrepeatability/permanent-choice metadata does not prohibit the replacements expressly allowed here. Canceling a proposed purchase before commitment spends no opportunity. A completed purchase is not refunded or repeated because no animal is available, a bond attempt fails, or a bond later ends. Animal Companion ownership alone can satisfy Companion Training's printed parent alternative, but supplies neither its separate feat opportunity nor a creature on which to use it.

NEW ACQ-05 bond attempt: an owner of this feat with actual Animal Handling proficiency, no current feat bond, no other pending bond attempt, an unspent attempt and any required post-bond-ending Long Rest may select one already real, positive-HP living, willing/tamed, noncorrupted Beast with INT<7 fitting one of the three finite templates. The selected animal must have no incompatible existing bond, including another Animal Companion or Ranger bond. Finding, buying or taming it still needs actual lawful access and its real willing/tamed relationship to this owner; no animal, stocked shop, consent or charm is supplied. Preserve its actual identity, ordinary profile, current/maximum HP, conditions, injuries, native movement, breathing, custody and required template choices. In one ordered start event, recheck admission, reserve this owner and animal for the work, spend the one attempt, and begin the hour. Merely proposing a target or rejecting it before that event does not spend an attempt; it never reverses a previously completed feat purchase. Starting costs no RP, second feat opportunity or universal fee. An attempt cannot begin while an existing feat bond is retained; such a rejected proposal does not release or alter that bond.

Spend one uninterrupted hour of actual bonding work together at touch range. Keep the same owner and animal, actual access, the required proficiency and animal eligibility throughout the work and at completion; the owner must remain able to perform it. This is active work, not beneficial rest, and grants no extra work Watch, assistant shortcut, handover or overlapping incompatible task. Loss of required touch-range access, willing/tamed eligibility, qualifying body state, or the owner's ability to continue, including incapacitation, or voluntary abandonment terminates the attempt. Elapsed time, real losses and the spent attempt persist; no partial hour, resumed fraction or same-epoch retry is awarded. The prospective animal remains in its actual current ordinary state; no feat profile or command entitlement was installed. After a full lawful hour, atomically complete the one bond and apply the existing template/HP conversion to the animal's latest lawful ordinary state, using the owner's then-current governing statistics. No new bond check or success chance is added. Admission alone or an incomplete hour cannot establish a companion.

The initial allowance is one attempt at feat purchase. Each genuinely completed beneficial owner Long Rest thereafter sets the allowance to one, never adds a stored second attempt. Apply FS-06's actual rest limits and one elapsed clock: no reset from Short Rest, debt-only Rest, a repeated rest receipt, a scene, a new target, a new controller, a new day label or level growth. Do not credit active bonding or release work as rest. An invalid claimed completion record is evidence rejection, not an attempt or feat-payment refund: reconcile the real start/interruption/rest history. Missing history cannot be replaced by an assumed unspent allowance. One feat bond at a time. Use the template corresponding to the real animal's body/native movement; do not turn a dog into a bird or grant a new breathing mode. Ordinary legal healing works, but no Hit Dice/rest-refill is invented. Use one shared BA command within60ft while the animal can perceive you: in its attached phase after your regular turn, move and make its one attack or Dash/Disengage/Help/Dodge. No independent turn/Reaction; uncommanded move defensively and Dodge. The animal's HP-only chassis dies at0, producing its one actual corpse and ending the bond, with no Wound/death-save sequence; this is a feat-specific NEW rule, not generic animal law. NEW ACQ-05 replacement boundary: when an established feat bond ends through release or death, record that actual ending event. Before this owner begins any later feat bond, require a genuinely beneficial owner Long Rest whose completion is ordered after that event, as well as an available attempt, a real eligible living target and the full new hour. A rest completed before the ending event or an unused prior allowance cannot satisfy that replacement gate. A qualifying completion after the event is sufficient; no additional rule requires the whole rest to have started after it. Existing active-work/rest restrictions still apply. Replacement is a use of the already-owned nonrepeatable feat, not a second purchase. NEW explicit rebond interpretation: a previously released living animal may be selected again if it genuinely qualifies; it is a new bond to the same physical individual, not a new or refreshed animal. A dead animal never becomes eligible merely through rest, release, purchase or this procedure. Voluntary release requires the owner's one uninterrupted hour of actual release work. NEW ACQ-05 release boundary: record its start, but end the bond only on lawful completion; interruption or abandonment grants no partial-hour credit and leaves the existing bond intact unless an independent event already ended it. A fresh release hour may be begun while the bond still exists. Release consumes no bond attempt, feat opportunity or RP. It does not require a second target or borrow the bonding hour's touch-range requirement; actual owner capacity and uninterrupted work remain mandatory. At completion restore the same living animal's saved ordinary profile with the existing positive-current-HP ratio conversion, preserving its current conditions, injuries and actual custody without healing or refilling it. Record this end for the post-ending Long-Rest gate. A creature cannot simultaneously have this and a Ranger bond, or two owners' Animal Companion bonds. NEW ACQ-05 correction of 'new paid acquisition': a transfer requires the outgoing bond to end through its actual lawful release/death/termination procedure, real lawful access/custody for the receiver, and the receiver's independently authorized new bond. An existing Animal Companion feat owner does not buy that nonrepeatable feat again; they spend their own available attempt and full hour and satisfy their own post-ending Long-Rest gate, if any. The sender's rest, feat ownership or spent attempt neither transfers nor resets the receiver's history. A receiver without this feat must first acquire it through their own actual eligible unspent opportunity, or use an independently acquired receiving engine; receiving the animal grants no feat or class feature. This never supplies autonomous attacks.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Spend ten active minutes closely inspecting one actual item with adequate sensory access and tools appropriate to safely examine it. NEW: make Intelligence (Investigation), DC10 for a plainly identifiable mundane object,15 for complex mundane construction,20 for an ordinary magical item, or25 for a unique unfamiliar construction; a specific item's explicit identification DC or concealment exception controls instead. Set the classification and actual information before rolling. On Success or Critical Success, learn its exact current reference value and complete discoverable operative properties, including magical properties and a curse unless that curse's specific source prevents this identification. Reference value means the recorded undamaged catalog price adjusted by the governing condition/valuation rule, or a Director-established local fair-market valuation when no catalog price exists, fixed before the roll. It is not a guaranteed purchase or sale offer. The property result states uses, limits, charges, activation and known operational risks from the actual item's complete record; it does not invent a missing profile, formula, historical truth or cosmology. A source explicitly resisting identification may withhold its protected part while other properties are identified. Safe appraisal is not activation or disarming; actual independent touch/proximity triggers remain. Failure spends time and yields no exact appraisal; another attempt needs changed evidence, access or method. This deliberately preserves a powerful item-identification benefit and requires direct comparison with Identify before adoption.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Action, once per short rest: choose one to three other willing allied creatures within30ft who can hear and understand the brief directive. Lock recipients and their order, spend the use, then resolve each sequentially. Each may spend its own available Reaction immediately for a separate floor(current relevant Speed/2)-ft movement-cost budget. Recheck hearing, willingness, position and capability at that recipient's resolution. Terrain and hazards apply; movement from this instruction provokes no opportunity attacks. Speed0 gives no movement. Declining or losing eligibility grants no replacement recipient and does not refund the commander; a recipient that does not move need not spend a Reaction. No ordinary movement/Action/BA resource is restored.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain Intimidation proficiency. When making an actual Intimidation check, you may substitute Strength for Charisma. NEW: declare that choice before rolling and describe an actual physically intimidating presentation the target can perceive; false impossible strength or an absent threat does not become evidence from the feat. This feat changes neither the ordinary social stakes nor the cost of violence, reputation, payment or consent. A successful check does not automatically impose Frightened, Charmed, obedience, a surrendered asset or a condition not included in the declared possible outcome. Commanding Presence remains a distinct source with its own reverse-substitution wording.

originalSourceObject.name: Cavalry
originalSourceObject.description: You are trained in mounted warfare.
originalSourceObject.effect: You have advantage on attacks against unmounted creatures while mounted, and your mount gains +10 feet movement speed.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: While legally riding a real mount under actual mounted/control/custody rules, your attacks have advantage against actual unmounted creatures. Retain the broad source: melee/ranged weapon, unarmed/natural and spell attacks qualify, with no target-size restriction. Save-only effects do not. Other disadvantage still cancels. The ridden mount's existing Speed modes each gain10ft while you remain its actual rider; NEW derive any mode explicitly equal to another Speed from that modified value rather than adding10 twice. No new mode is created, and Speed0 restrictions override the increase. Multiple Cavalry riders give one+10 family bonus, not one per passenger. The feat creates no mount, control permission, mount attack, shared Action pool or extra turn. Mounted Combatant remains a separate narrower feat with no double advantage. Exact mounting, load and shared-space procedures must follow the actual expedition/transport verdict when returned.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Literal broad attack advantage, current real mount, existing-mode+10 and no passenger stacking.
submittedWorkedCases: A mounted archer attacks an unmounted giant: Cavalry advantage applies despite its size, subject to other disadvantage.
Two Cavalry passengers do not give a horse+20Speed; no flying Speed appears on a walking-only mount.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt the bounded proposal with the completed EX58 controller/phase/physical-history interface; no future transport dependency or extra animal turn.

originalSourceObject.name: Commanding Presence
originalSourceObject.description: You naturally command respect.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can use your Charisma modifier instead of Strength for Intimidation checks, and you have advantage on Persuasion checks against creatures of lower level.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: When an actual Intimidation task would use Strength, you may use Charisma instead; choose before rolling. Ordinary Charisma (Intimidation) already uses Charisma, so this clause gives no second modifier or bonus there. It does not grant proficiency. On actual Persuasion checks directed at a creature with an explicitly recorded character level lower than your total character level, gain advantage. NEW: compare true character levels, not CR, Hit Dice, faction standing, rank or apparent seniority. A creature with only CR and no character level is not qualified through a fabricated conversion; its Director can supply an actual level only if its real profile legitimately includes one. Check eligibility at the roll, without granting the speaker metagame disclosure of the hidden value. Equal or higher level gives no advantage from this clause. All actual social possibilities, agency and costs remain.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Charisma substitution retained as written; exact level comparison and explicit no CR conversion. This limitation needs joint source agreement.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: When you actually cause a living dying creature to become Stable by a legal Medicine stabilization or a real healer's-kit use, offer that recipient 1 HP. Use the ordinary Action/DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) route or the ordinary Action/one-kit-use route; an independently owned feature may explicitly change that action cost. NEW: treat the 1 HP as a direct state-recovery grant following the completed stabilization, not ordinary rolled healing. Broad cannot-regain-HP restrictions and the living-target gate apply; it receives no ordinary healing bonuses. Record one Field-Surgeon-family entitlement per recipient's own completed-long-rest epoch, shared across all practitioners. Commit it on the eligible offer even when HP gain is blocked. The actual stabilization remains recorded; if recovery is blocked the creature stays Stable at 0 with its normal existing recovery deadline. If positive HP is gained, clear the obsolete Stable deadline normally. A separately owned Field Medic temp-HP offer still uses the genuine stabilization event, even if the recipient is now at 1 HP. Already Stable or dead creatures create no new trigger.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Direct recovery classification; recipient family lock; blocked-offer consumption and event ordering. GPT must decide this classification against the current healing contract.
submittedWorkedCases: Medicine succeeds for a dying recipient: record stabilization, then recover 1 HP and end zero-HP unconsciousness if no independent cause remains. A later practitioner cannot supply a second Field Surgeon point before that recipient completes a long rest.
Decay blocks HP gain: the recipient remains Stable 0 and the feat entitlement is spent. Field Medic may still offer its separately legal temporary HP, which do not wake the recipient.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt direct 1-HP recovery after genuine stabilization and shared recipient LR-offer lock; keep broad recovery blockers, independent Field Medic and existing bodily consequences.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: After your direct attack critically hits a meaningful hostile, other allied creatures within30ft that can actually see or hear you at that instant gain+1 to their attack rolls through your next original regular start. NEW recipients are fixed at the trigger, with no continuing range/hearing tether; allies entering later do not gain the old inspiration. No common language is required. You are not your own recipient. Any genuine critical-if-hit result qualifies, not just natural20; automatic-hit wording without a critical does not. Same-feat overlapping records never add beyond+1, and independent expiry records remain. Another legitimate critical can renew eligible allies but cannot duplicate the number. Preserve older+5%damage/10seconds as history; current effect is+1attack, not damage.

originalSourceObject.effect: You can recruit followers and hirelings more easily, and they are more loyal to you.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW finite recruitment/loyalty procedure: during a real recruitment effort, designate up to current PB actual willing prospective followers or hirelings. Spend one active hour interviewing and briefing them, agree on their actual jobs, pay, duration, risk, equipment and departure terms, and gain+2 on any legitimate Persuasion checks to secure those agreements. An automatic willing agreement needs no roll. The feat creates no candidate, free wage, stat block, level, binding, summoned unit or extra class companion. Keep at most PB current designated contracts receiving the feat's loyalty benefit; designate at agreement or at a new hour-long briefing, never retroactively during a morale event. While the employer honors the terms and the work remains within the agreed risk, a designated follower gains+2 on an actual loyalty/morale check whose purpose is deciding whether to abandon that agreement under pressure. This is not a bonus against every fear spell or a compulsion to stay; no roll is invented where the person's real decision is certain. Broken terms, unpaid wages or an unagreed suicidal demand remove this benefit until genuinely repaired and re-briefed. Actual transport, expedition caps, combat turns and command budgets continue to govern each recruited person. Dismissal ends designation without transferring any creature's property or earned wages.

Independent touch, proximity, damage, time, wrong-key or tampering triggers still operate at their own actual moments even on a success. Thievery's acquisition bridge is specified in the shared proposal.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Use with an actual willing transaction in ordinary mundane goods, a finite buyer/seller and a quoted quantity. Exclude artifacts, magic-item effects, labor/services, taxes, guild tariffs and monopolies unless their own exact rule expressly admits ordinary negotiation. NEW procedure: before the check the provider states its ordinary quote, whether the deal is negotiable, the supported improvement ceiling0–10%, the relevant approach and a concrete price-persuasion DC, default15 for an ordinary receptive negotiation. Spend10actual minutes and make CHA/Persuasion for honest bargaining, CHA/Deception for an actual plausible misrepresentation, or an actually applicable established Profession credential with its ordinary ability; this does not create a new Profession skill. Success or Critical Success gives the agreed ceiling, default10% if a negotiable ordinary deal has no smaller stated ceiling; Failure/Critical Failure gives no feat discount and preserves the source’s actual deception consequences. The result changes the final otherwise-negotiated purchase by×(1-ceiling) or sale by×(1+ceiling), before final copper rounding, with no double count of the same concession. NEW same concession family: multiple owners/repeated checks cannot compound this feat or claim another10% on the same deal. A change of speaker or splitting one order does not reset unchanged-state negotiation. Keep the actual provider’s predeclared floor/ceiling and refusal; no roll creates stock, consent or guaranteed profit. Reconcile the final58-question social/settlement verdict before adoption.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: 10-minute/defaultDC15 negotiation, preregistered0–10% feasible ceiling, success award and same-concession family.
submittedWorkedCases: A real100gp ordinary sale quote with an agreed10% ceiling becomes110gp after a successful check. Two feat owners cannot turn that same negotiated deal into121gp.

A fixed guild tariff remains fixed. A separately willing ordinary seller offering only a3% concession gives3% on success, with the ceiling disclosed before work; the feat does not secretly convert success into a different costly-agreement outcome.
sourceDirection.decision: Retain predeclared attainable mundane bargain and10% maximum; FEX03 binds the10min subtask within unchanged disposition/settlement work.

Resolve continuous versus snapshot eligibility, multiple leaders and hard-control/compulsion boundaries without forced loyalty.

originalSourceObject.name: Natural Leader
originalSourceObject.description: A Charisma 13+ leader steadies nearby allies with the feat's listed +1 morale.
originalSourceObject.effect: Allies within 10 feet who can hear you gain +1 on morale and fear saves while you are conscious.
originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: While conscious and capable of audible direction, other allied creatures within10ft who can actually hear you gain+1 on real morale saves and saves against effects that actually impose fear/Frightened. NEW no common language is required for this rallying presence, but silence, Deafened and sound-blocking barriers can prevent hearing. Check current radius/hearing when each save occurs; leaving ends the benefit without an expiry timer. It applies only to saves the actual source calls for: do not invent a morale save, turn an ordinary persuasion check into one, compel loyalty or prevent voluntary withdrawal. Same-feat multiple leaders give at most+1; a separately sourced actual bonus follows its own family. You are not your own ally for this feature.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Continuous other-ally audible aura and source-qualified save predicate.
submittedWorkedCases: An ally8ft away hearing the leader adds1 to a genuine fear save.
An ally decides to retreat voluntarily: the aura does not force a morale check or take away that decision.
sourceDirection.decision: Keep actual source ally wording including self, with original target/sensory/budget conditions; no generalized automatic self-target for inherently two-person effects.

originalSourceObject.name: Negotiator
originalSourceObject.description: You excel at making deals.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can negotiate better prices for goods and services, and you have advantage on Persuasion checks during negotiations.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain advantage on actual Persuasion checks during negotiations for real goods or services. NEW: before the check, establish the seller/buyer's available stock, normal quote, attainable concession, payment and conditions. A successful check secures that announced better quote or term; no universal percentage discount or guaranteed buyer is created. A concession can be a lower price, improved payment schedule, delivery, included fitting or a better actual sale offer, with its exact value set before rolling. The counterpart must have authority and willingness to consider it. Failed unchanged negotiations cannot be repeated by restating the same bargain or swapping speakers without a materially changed offer or evidence. Distinct standing, sponsor and service benefits use their own actual clauses; advantage does not stack. Different purchase and resale quotes remain separate, and this feat never establishes a same-price repurchase promise or circular money source. Record the final agreement and any taxes/fees through the actual settlement procedure.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Predeclared exact concession and finite bargain record; no invented blanket percentage. Full live market/social procedure supplies numeric quote limits.
submittedWorkedCases: A merchant offers a possible reduction from50gp to45gp on success. A successful advantaged check secures45gp under the announced terms; it does not also apply another unprinted10% discount.
Buying for45gp does not force any buyer to repurchase for50gp. A later actual resale uses that buyer's own stock, demand and quote.

sourceObject.description: The beast inside listens before the mind does. You trust that older voice. Prestige lineage: Mooncursed. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.effect: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing or smell. You cannot be surprised while conscious. You can track creatures across difficult terrain without penalty. Under moonlight or while transformed, you gain +2 to initiative and once per short rest you may howl or roar as a free action: allies within 30 feet who can hear you gain advantage on their next attack against a creature you are tracking or have damaged this encounter.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain advantage on actualWIS Perception checks relying on working hearing or smell, without a passive±5 adjustment. While conscious, surprise restrictions are suppressed as in Alert, with no retroactive actions. When actually tracking a real trail, ignore penalties caused solely by difficult terrain; preserve absent evidence, concealment, age, weather and source-specific no-trace restrictions. NEW the moonlight/transformed clause qualifies both the+2initiative and howl: at the actual initiative roll, if physically illuminated by real existing moonlight or in an actual body-transforming form, add2. It does not establish an astronomical calendar, count a moon-themed spell as moonlight, or treat an illusion/disguise as body transformation. Once perSR while that predicate holds, on your own regular turn without an Action cost, audibly howl/roar and choose one actual creature you are currently tracking through a legal source or personally damaged during this encounter. Other allies within30ft who hear at the moment gain advantage on their next attack against that chosen creature before your next future regular end. NEW recipient list and target are fixed, no continuing range tether and no extra attack; one family entitlement per ally, consumed by its first eligible attack hit/miss/cancellation. The body must actually be able to howl or roar; articulated speech or a shared language is not required. Silence or an anatomy unable to make that sound prevents it. Conditions otherwise permit this brief free communication but do not grantActions. Tracking alone does not reveal a target's present location for an attack.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Actual hearing/smell, terrain-only tracking relief, literal moonlight/body-change predicate and complete free-own-turnSR howl contract.
submittedWorkedCases: A transformed owner howls on its turn for a foe it actually damaged; hearing allies receive one next-attack advantage through the owner's next regular end.
A moon-painted lantern is not actual moonlight. The feat creates neither transformation access nor current location knowledge from an old trail.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Add +2 to an actual Persuasion check conducted through diplomacy, negotiation or mediation of a stated agreement, dispute or exchange. NEW: formal describes an acknowledged purposeful exchange with an identifiable request and stakes, not a requirement for court clothing or an official office. The affected party must receive and understand the argument through a legal direct or interpreted channel. Use the social procedure's actual eligibility, DC, stakes, evidence, cost and retry rule. The feat supplies no automatic discount, consent, altered reputation, loyalty, treaty enforcement or permission to ask an impossible favor. A Deception lie, Intimidation threat or unrelated Performance does not receive this Persuasion bonus merely because it occurs in a negotiation. Clothing and other modifiers retain their actual separate qualifications and the shared proposed stacking rule.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Practical formal-exchange definition and language bridge; no proposed social DC or reputation change.
submittedWorkedCases: A clearly stated bargain for a real porter service can qualify for +2 on a required Persuasion check. The bonus does not remove the agreed wage or invent an available porter.
An Intimidation check threatening a guard gets no Silver Tongue bonus, even when described as hard negotiation.
sourceDirection.decision: Keep +2 purposeful formal Persuasion and actual understood channel; apply completed EX58 social agency, time and no automatic economic award.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW feat-only geometry: you and one other willing allied, non-Incapacitated creature each threaten the same enemy with an actual legal melee attack, and the straight segment joining your occupied-space centers crosses the interior of that enemy's occupied footprint, placing you on opposite sides. Measure actual occupied bodies on the current map; a large creature needs opposite sides of its whole footprint, not merely two nearby squares. Both participants must perceive the target and be able to attack it; total cover or unusable reach prevents flanking. This geometry itself grants no universal advantage. Once per turn, when either participant hits that enemy with a melee attack, you may assign your feat allowance to add1d6 of one native damage type to that hit before damage is rolled. No Action/Reaction is required, but you must be conscious and able to coordinate. One successful attack may receive only one Tactical Flanker die across all owners; choose its funding owner before rolling. A critical doubles this attack rider die. Misses spend nothing; using your allowance on an ally prevents using it again on your own hit that actual turn. Perception/reach/geometry must hold at the hit.

sourceDirection.completeAuthoringProcedure:
Bonus Action, once per short rest: while holding an actual usable weapon, choose a creature you can see within its current melee reach or printed maximum ranged range, with line of effect. A thrown weapon uses its actual range; ordinary long-range disadvantages remain. Record the chosen weapon only to establish activation range; stowing it later does not end the mark. For1minute, the first attack against the marked creature by each creature currently allied to you, including yourself, gains+1 to hit. This is once per ally identity for the entire mark, not per turn, and is consumed by that attack even if it misses. You are an eligible ally for your own mark. A creature's later alliance change does not reset its used identity; a newly arriving genuine ally can use its own first attack. Only one mark per owner; replacement, owner death or expiry ends the old record. NEW owner incapacitation does not end an existing mark. No continuous range/tether after activation and no vision/targeting permission is granted. Multiple marks never give more than+1 to the same attack; all applicable unspent first-attack entitlements for that attacker consume on that first event.
SOURCE SCOPE CORRECTION: “allies” includes the feat owner unless the actual clause says “other.” The owner must still meet the same hearing/perception, range, willing-target and action/resource predicates. No second body, observer or extra action is created by self-eligibility. This sentence supersedes any narrower owner-exclusion in the submitted proposal, not the preserved original.
NEW weapon-range completion: at activation use an actually held, usable weapon’s current reach or printed ranged range, including a melee weapon’s reach; a ranged weapon is not mandatory. Long range does not remove its ordinary disadvantage. Marking does not grant an attack, visibility or line of effect. The mark’s +1 applies to each qualifying ally’s first attack against that target, including the owner’s. Multiple marks of this same feat give one+1 and consume all applicable first-attack entitlements on that event.

sourceObject.name: Trapsetter
sourceObject.description: Tripwire, caltrop, and charge—the ground remembers your name and bites when asked. Prestige lineage: Sapper. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.prerequisite: Proficiency in Engineering or Disable Device
sourceObject.effect: You can set a mechanical trap as a bonus action (once per short rest per trap type: snare, caltrop field, or spring-loaded charge). Traps may stun, burn, or slow on a failed save (DC 8 + proficiency + Intelligence modifier). You gain advantage on checks to spot hidden traps and tunnels within 30 feet. When a creature triggers a trap you placed, you may use your reaction to move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature, repositioning behind cover or into a prepared kill-zone.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Require Engineering proficiency or the proposed mechanical Disable Device/thieves’-tools credential. NEW three closed prepared-kit options use genuine physical parts and no invented recipe/craft XP: snare (5gp reference,2lb cord/spring/anchor), caltrop field (the actual ordinary20-caltrop source bag, preserving its price/weight), and spring-loaded charge (25gp reference,3lb trigger body plus actual prepared combustible filling). Availability and assembly are real: obtain a genuinely prepared kit from an actual provider, or spend30active minutes with suitable mechanical tools and the same actual parts, DC12 INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves’-tools, using Core binary task outcome. Failure consumes time and expendable cord/filling, retaining only real recoverable frame/metal parts; no free complete kit. The new reference prices are complete kit references, not added again to their component prices. No ordinary Rune or Tinkering formula is silently renamed one of these three options.

Place one held/accessible prepared kit in a real stable unoccupied5-foot ground square within5feet. Normally this feat procedure takes an Action; once per Short Rest for each of the three types, you may use a Bonus Action instead, spending that type’s separate quick-placement allowance. NEW one armed trap of each type per setter; arming a replacement disarms the old one without refund or teleportation. It arms at your next original regular-turn start, or after six elapsed seconds outside initiative, preserving the same deadline across mode changes. SnapshotDC8+PB+INT modifier at placement. The first actual grounded creature entering from outside, including an ally, forced movement or teleport arrival, triggers once; an existing occupant, flying above it, or replayed movement is not another entry. The target makesDEXsave against the storedDC. On failure: snare givesStunned until the target’s next regular-turn end; charge deals2d6fire in that same event with no ongoing Burn; caltrop field uses the reviewed ordinary caltrop failure effect of1piercing, stopping remaining movement that turn and-10walkingSpeed until1HPhealing or an Action removes the caltrop. The caltrop slow is one shared same-area effect, not a new Slow condition, and moving at halfSpeed still avoids its save as under its actual item rule. Success avoids the trap’s feat effect. NEW these fields discharge after that first eligible trigger regardless of result; surviving actual metal/body can be recovered, but rearming requires a new prepared kit procedure/consumed expendables. A charge consumes its filling; this does not duplicate its frame. Placement speed does not shorten preparation or refill after transfer.

The exposed snare/charge assembly isAC15/5HP; caltrops retain their actual ordinary physical pieces. An Action with safe reach disarms your own accessible trap. Another creature that has detected it can spend an Action with actual appropriate tools onDCequal to storedDC using INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves’-tools; failure triggers it only if that actual manipulation enters its working trigger, not arbitrarily against a remote observer. Hidden placement requires actual concealment: record one real setter DEX/Stealth check opposed by the actual search/passive-perception procedure, without granting invisibility. Once visible, ordinary physical removal/destruction still follows actual reach/safety and object rules. A trap that is moved,Broken,covered or disconnected becomes disarmed and needs real rearming; reconstruction never duplicates stock or the type’s spent quick-placement use.

You have advantage on actual checks to spot hidden traps or tunnel evidence within30feet, not automatic sight through walls or knowledge that a tunnel exists. On a real trigger of any trap you personally placed, after its immediate effect resolves and if you are still capable of taking a Reaction and can perceive the triggering creature within30feet, you may spend that Reaction to move up to half your current applicable Speed. Pay ordinary terrain/mode costs from this distinct movement budget, respect speed0/restraints and actual paths. This movement provokes no opportunity attack from that triggering creature; other creatures’ normal opportunity attacks remain. You may use real cover or a real prepared kill-zone at the destination, but the feat creates neither. One trigger event permits at most one Reaction; copies, already discharged traps and additional targets of one blast are not new triggers.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Three finite real kits/effects/preparation; per-type fast-placement budget and armed cap; actual trigger,detection,disarm and recovery;30-foot perceived Reaction scope.
submittedWorkedCases: You quick-place a snare, then transfer the kit before it arms. Moving it disarms it; a later placement does not refund your already spent snare quick-placement use. Caltrop and charge fast-placement uses remain independently available.

An enemy triggers your charge within30feet; after the save/damage you react and move up to half your current Speed behind an existing wall. That enemy cannot make an opportunity attack for this movement, but another eligible adjacent foe still can.
sourceDirection.decision: Restore persistent ordinary caltrop hazard and physical disarm; retain finite prepared snare/charge, setup budgets and source-scoped reaction movement without remote deletion or recycled hard denial.

FT84 source-follow-through selection (proposed; the following explicit interaction controls only this named composition):
FT84-Q03 / FT84-CLOSED-CREATION-01 — Craftsman applies to actual authorized creation, not names or all fixed-duration work.
INTERPRETATION SELECTED: personally leading an independently authorized closed feat process that makes/assembles a new usable physical body or prepared kit is eligible creation even when it is non-artisan, lacks a catalog recipe ID or prints a fixed base duration. Craftsman supplies only its half-active-time factor; it supplies no process, skill, formula, assistants, work opportunity, materials, use or output. Use the strongest genuinely applicable creation reduction once. An explicit source exclusion or distinct alteration/preparation/service category still controls. Keep actual physical minimum phases only where the source requires them; do not manufacture an advanced-recipe incorporation phase for every short feat process.
Contraption Crafter's ten minutes are the ordinary base for its real gadget construction. With actual personally leading Craftsman ownership the complete job is five uninterrupted active minutes, not ten with a final five-minute discount and not two-and-a-half from a second equivalent half. The whole adjusted job must be uninterrupted; phase logging, assistant handoff, pauses, rest or partially completed earlier attempts cannot satisfy it. Keep actual Gnome heritage, usable tinker's tools, the same five-gp suitable owned parts and the same once-per-24-elapsed-hours use committed at start. A new lawful construction still ends its old gadget at start. Interruption spends the committed parts/use and yields no working gadget, no completion roll, no refundable tail and no resumable partial product. Completion rolls the same one d4 openly, once; it grants no chosen profile, duplicate gadget, general proficiency, quality, recipe XP or parts recovery. The same one-hour gadget lifetime starts at actual completion, not at the undiscounted hypothetical finish. Transfer/deployment/activation/recharge rules are unchanged. The time benefit is prospective and cannot manufacture a mid-job feat acquisition opportunity; if a real change interrupts the required work, the ordinary failure consequence applies.
Trapsetter's independently authorized thirty-active-minute kit assembly is likewise eligible creation: fifteen active minutes with Craftsman. This includes only its actual prepared-kit assembly from the real source parts; it cannot manufacture an ordinary twenty-caltrop stock bag out of an arbitrary substitute or count buying/deploying one as new creation. Keep the one completion DC12 INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves-tools check, ordinary task degree/natural shifts collapsed to binary, actual parts, failure consumption and recoverable remaining metal/frame. No manufacturing quality/yield/XP or general recipe is added. NEW NARROW WORK-CREDIT COMPLETION for this otherwise unphased kit assembly: track actual active work in seconds against the adjusted required total; pauses do not by themselves erase already completed usable physical assembly work. completeCurrentRule.title: Roll type, reroll window and targets
completeCurrentRule.wording:
KEEP attacks versus AC, binary saves, fixed-DC Core tasks with natural shifts, and opposed totals with unchanged-state ties lost by the initiator. A +10 attack margin is not a critical. Natural 1/20 on attacks retain their attack rules; saves do not acquire task shifts. A failed-save reroll replaces the whole original one- or two-d20 procedure with the same actual modifiers and advantage/disadvantage, before consequences, unless the exact feat instead replaces a named die position. Use the replacement even if worse; a source cannot reroll its own replacement. Lucky and Elven Accuracy keep their separately specified die-position rules. Costs and prior consequences are not rolled back.
KEEP the current class target convention: 'ally' includes the owner unless the source says OTHER, or real geometry/activity inherently requires a different creature. Do not count the same person twice in 'you and an ally', a team, a flanking pair or an assistance role. 'Enemy' requires an actual current opponent, not every creature in range; meaningful-hostility and anti-farm gates apply only where the source/this register binds resource or encounter rewards. Do not add an enemy or anatomy gate to an unrelated ordinary attack merely as a blanket convention. Source perception, actual reach/line of effect, body eligibility and willing/understood channels remain real.

CURRENT ADOPTED MENTAL-EFFECT PREDICATE (FS-05). A qualifying mental-effect save is the effect's own save to prevent or end Charmed, Frightened, possession, compelled actions/speech, or an explicitly described alteration of thoughts, memories, beliefs, emotions or perceived sensory reality; also include a save directly against psychic damage. Actual concentration maintenance is a separate save, not automatically a mental-effect save because psychic damage caused it. A generic INT/WIS/CHA save, mundane physical hazard or ordinary social check does not qualify solely by ability or theme. Tag the actual effect and outcome before the roll. This is the finite source definition already adopted for Iron Will and Resilient Mind; it supplies no new roll, immunity or concentration permission.

completeCurrentRule.title: Actions, command channels, mounts and personal movement
completeCurrentRule.wording:
Keep one additional FULL Action per creature/numbered round and the existing prohibition on additional Actions generating another additional Action/Bonus Action/Reaction. A source that explicitly grants a separate later Bonus Action has only its named window. Free attacks are not full Actions and cannot recursively grant other free attacks unless an exact existing exception says so. Ordinary Attack Action, card technique, weapon attack, spell attack and cantrip are not interchangeable labels.
Use one physical creature identity, controller record, movement pool and authoritative phase. All controlled companions retain the governed shared Bonus Action command and one offensive/control companion action per owner/round. A source may command two bodies for nonoffensive actions only where stated; it does not grant two offensive actions. The feat owner must actually send the required audible/visible/mental channel; known language, trained signals, Silence and source range matter. Existing Tinker devices use actual reviewed channels and shared budgets.
A bonded animal may be a mount only if its actual body, training, size, seat, tack, load and access meet EX58. It does not gain a second phase for being both companion and mount. Register the applicable EX58 mounted-control phase before operation; do not switch schemas midround to obtain unused budgets. Unmounted feat companions use the explicitly supplied after-owner-regular-turn phase. Mount and rider remain separate targets and actor budgets. Cavalry adds10 to each ACTUAL existing mount locomotion Speed while legally ridden, before applicable burden, terrain and later multipliers; it creates no mode, carrying capacity or engine. Route pace uses the actual resulting limiting profile under EX58, not a second free journey. The rider's being carried is not personal walking, Dragoon Momentum or a movement-cost discount. Mount/dismount uses the actual half-current-walk movement cost, access, one-per-regular-interval allowance and fitting seat; an extra Action does not reset it.

completeCurrentRule.title: Appraisal, bargaining, social outcomes and settlement
completeCurrentRule.wording:

It can discover actual unprotected operative magical properties and curses as specified in its exact row; it is not a Divination spell by name and does not infer history, secret identities or cosmology. Source-specific identification protections still apply. Use the row's10/15/20/25 standalone DC fallback only where no actual controlling task/item DC exists. Within Haven's appraisal operation use its actual source/task DC (explicit or tier12/13/15/16/18/19), retain the FULL30-minute lot/item procedure, and count the holder's ten-minute inspection as a real nonoverlapping subtask inside it when the same person/work actually satisfies both. No second roll is created by the label.
A ten-minute bargaining feat likewise occupies only its real subtask of the full30-minute Haven disposition; record the remainder for inspection, agreement and transfer. It does not halve those30minutes or remove provenance, hearing, claims, settlement, sponsor/tax/assay or worker shifts. Standalone transactions can use their own actual procedure without inventing compulsory Haven fees. Predeclare the attainable concession, DC, price basis and costs; on success honor the promised outcome, not a newly imposed 'costly agreement' after the roll. No check compels impossible terms, an absent seller or a player belief. Standing remains EX58 -3..+3 with signed per-scene award bounded±2; aliases and background initialization never erase earned history.
Reference value, actual offer, sale gross and net receipts remain separate. Use exact rational currency until the final purchase-ceiling/sale-floor copper rounding. Apply a named discount once to its agreed eligible basis, never to taxes or paid fees by association. Keep the actual greater-of assay rule and sponsor deductions from EX58-EDIT-02; no10% fine cap is revived. Known properties do not mint stock, title, formula knowledge, free service, wages or a guaranteed buyer.

completeCurrentRule.title: Real work, crafting/repair and time reductions
completeCurrentRule.wording:
Use actual artisan/non-artisan credentials, source recipe DC/inputs/assistant caps/maximum ordered complete bodies, incorporation phase and hours. Feat proficiency does not make a non-artisan credential an artisan tool. A reduction to a named work category changes only its active minutes. For competing same-purpose fractional work/material reductions take the strongest permitted factor once, not their product; distinct time and material bases remain separate. Fixed calendar/waiting/access requirements are not shortened. Retain real minimum physical phases: never omit the actual first15-minute incorporation or make a reduced task finish before its necessary work. Unfinished phases, actual loss and return clocks remain. No third work Watch, automatic research evidence, recipe, learner, assistant, XP or free body is created.
KEEP Tinker Adept's explicitly NEW at-most30-active-minute exception inside the holder's actual beneficial Short Rest: only an entire independently authorized repair whose required active work fits that allowance qualifies. The whole repair uses actual tools, materials, safe compatible light activity and current body; do not stage the last30minutes of an eight-hour repair inside Rest to claim this exception. Add PB only to successful structural CURRENT-HP restoration up to existing maximum, once; ordinary full-restoration repairs often gain0 additional HP. It changes no missing-primary requirement, charge, service, dawn counter, fuel, custody or terminal dismantling history. Repair, maintenance, servicing and rest are different transitions. Bowyer/Master Smithing and the three Trapsetter bodies use only their expressly NEW closed processes and stocks, not unprinted equivalents of all687 recipes.

## Inspiring Leader — General; Charisma13+

Speak for ten uninterrupted minutes. At the start, select up to your current PB **other** willing creatures within30ft. Snapshot your character level and actual signed Charisma modifier then. Each selected creature must remain in range, hear and understand you throughout. No replacements or retargeting during the speech.

If one listener loses eligibility, only that listener misses the benefit. If the speaker becomes Incapacitated, cannot continue speaking or abandons the speech, the whole unfinished performance fails. Interrupted speeches spend no recipient entitlements and have no owner per-rest use; the speaker may begin again. Later changes in the speaker's statistics do not change this performance's snapshot. Temporary CHA below13 after acquisition does not disable ownership.

**NEW:** other-creature restriction, count, range/language/presence gates, amount, snapshots and family rest limit.

originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: At the adopted normal travel pace, you may use passive Perception to notice a trap's actually detectable clue. NEW: compare 10 plus the relevant Wisdom (Perception) modifier, with applicable PB once, to the trap's stated detection DC; meeting it notices the clue. There is no natural d20 or generic passive ±5 from advantage/disadvantage. A source explicitly requiring an active search or a different sense still controls; concealment, line, range and sensory access remain. Detecting a clue does not reveal every component or disarm the device. Add +2 to a saving throw against a trap you can actually see at the save event, including a visible operative component sufficient to recognize the incoming trap effect. A remembered location behind total visual obstruction is not sight. An ordinary creature attack or unrelated hazard is not a trap solely because it surprises you. If a source explicitly classifies a magical installation as a trap, retain that classification and its save rules.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Passive detection arithmetic and tie; actual sight at save; classification boundary. Must be checked against full hazard source verdict.
submittedWorkedCases: Passive 15 notices an accessible trap clue at DC 15 during normal-pace travel. A completely invisible clue with no applicable sense is not noticed by the arithmetic alone.
The character saw a floor plate earlier but is now blinded: its current save receives no sight-dependent +2. Remembering it can still inform a voluntary route choice.

trapsetter.name: Trapsetter

sourceObject.name: Trapsetter
sourceObject.description: Tripwire, caltrop, and charge—the ground remembers your name and bites when asked. Prestige lineage: Sapper. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.prerequisite: Proficiency in Engineering or Disable Device
sourceObject.effect: You can set a mechanical trap as a bonus action (once per short rest per trap type: snare, caltrop field, or spring-loaded charge). Traps may stun, burn, or slow on a failed save (DC 8 + proficiency + Intelligence modifier). You gain advantage on checks to spot hidden traps and tunnels within 30 feet. When a creature triggers a trap you placed, you may use your reaction to move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature, repositioning behind cover or into a prepared kill-zone.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Require Engineering proficiency or the proposed mechanical Disable Device/thieves’-tools credential. NEW three closed prepared-kit options use genuine physical parts and no invented recipe/craft XP: snare (5gp reference,2lb cord/spring/anchor), caltrop field (the actual ordinary20-caltrop source bag, preserving its price/weight), and spring-loaded charge (25gp reference,3lb trigger body plus actual prepared combustible filling). Availability and assembly are real: obtain a genuinely prepared kit from an actual provider, or spend30active minutes with suitable mechanical tools and the same actual parts, DC12 INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves’-tools, using Core binary task outcome. Failure consumes time and expendable cord/filling, retaining only real recoverable frame/metal parts; no free complete kit. The new reference prices are complete kit references, not added again to their component prices. No ordinary Rune or Tinkering formula is silently renamed one of these three options.

Place one held/accessible prepared kit in a real stable unoccupied5-foot ground square within5feet. Normally this feat procedure takes an Action; once per Short Rest for each of the three types, you may use a Bonus Action instead, spending that type’s separate quick-placement allowance. NEW one armed trap of each type per setter; arming a replacement disarms the old one without refund or teleportation. It arms at your next original regular-turn start, or after six elapsed seconds outside initiative, preserving the same deadline across mode changes. SnapshotDC8+PB+INT modifier at placement. The first actual grounded creature entering from outside, including an ally, forced movement or teleport arrival, triggers once; an existing occupant, flying above it, or replayed movement is not another entry. The target makesDEXsave against the storedDC. On failure: snare givesStunned until the target’s next regular-turn end; charge deals2d6fire in that same event with no ongoing Burn; caltrop field uses the reviewed ordinary caltrop failure effect of1piercing, stopping remaining movement that turn and-10walkingSpeed until1HPhealing or an Action removes the caltrop. The caltrop slow is one shared same-area effect, not a new Slow condition, and moving at halfSpeed still avoids its save as under its actual item rule. Success avoids the trap’s feat effect. NEW these fields discharge after that first eligible trigger regardless of result; surviving actual metal/body can be recovered, but rearming requires a new prepared kit procedure/consumed expendables. A charge consumes its filling; this does not duplicate its frame. Placement speed does not shorten preparation or refill after transfer.

The exposed snare/charge assembly isAC15/5HP; caltrops retain their actual ordinary physical pieces. An Action with safe reach disarms your own accessible trap. Another creature that has detected it can spend an Action with actual appropriate tools onDCequal to storedDC using INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves’-tools; failure triggers it only if that actual manipulation enters its working trigger, not arbitrarily against a remote observer. Hidden placement requires actual concealment: record one real setter DEX/Stealth check opposed by the actual search/passive-perception procedure, without granting invisibility. Once visible, ordinary physical removal/destruction still follows actual reach/safety and object rules. A trap that is moved,Broken,covered or disconnected becomes disarmed and needs real rearming; reconstruction never duplicates stock or the type’s spent quick-placement use.

You have advantage on actual checks to spot hidden traps or tunnel evidence within30feet, not automatic sight through walls or knowledge that a tunnel exists. On a real trigger of any trap you personally placed, after its immediate effect resolves and if you are still capable of taking a Reaction and can perceive the triggering creature within30feet, you may spend that Reaction to move up to half your current applicable Speed. Pay ordinary terrain/mode costs from this distinct movement budget, respect speed0/restraints and actual paths. This movement provokes no opportunity attack from that triggering creature; other creatures’ normal opportunity attacks remain. You may use real cover or a real prepared kill-zone at the destination, but the feat creates neither. One trigger event permits at most one Reaction; copies, already discharged traps and additional targets of one blast are not new triggers.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Three finite real kits/effects/preparation; per-type fast-placement budget and armed cap; actual trigger,detection,disarm and recovery;30-foot perceived Reaction scope.
submittedWorkedCases: You quick-place a snare, then transfer the kit before it arms. Moving it disarms it; a later placement does not refund your already spent snare quick-placement use. Caltrop and charge fast-placement uses remain independently available.

An enemy triggers your charge within30feet; after the save/damage you react and move up to half your current Speed behind an existing wall. That enemy cannot make an opportunity attack for this movement, but another eligible adjacent foe still can.

cavalry.originalQuestion: Retain source mounted advantage against unmounted creatures and mount+10ft Speed. Define attack types, target sizes, legal riding/control and which movement modes increase. sourceDirection.name: Cavalry

originalSourceObject.name: Cavalry
originalSourceObject.description: You are trained in mounted warfare.
originalSourceObject.effect: You have advantage on attacks against unmounted creatures while mounted, and your mount gains +10 feet movement speed.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: While legally riding a real mount under actual mounted/control/custody rules, your attacks have advantage against actual unmounted creatures. Retain the broad source: melee/ranged weapon, unarmed/natural and spell attacks qualify, with no target-size restriction. Save-only effects do not. Other disadvantage still cancels. The ridden mount's existing Speed modes each gain10ft while you remain its actual rider; NEW derive any mode explicitly equal to another Speed from that modified value rather than adding10 twice. No new mode is created, and Speed0 restrictions override the increase. Multiple Cavalry riders give one+10 family bonus, not one per passenger. The feat creates no mount, control permission, mount attack, shared Action pool or extra turn. Mounted Combatant remains a separate narrower feat with no double advantage. Exact mounting, load and shared-space procedures must follow the actual expedition/transport verdict when returned.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Literal broad attack advantage, current real mount, existing-mode+10 and no passenger stacking.
submittedWorkedCases: A mounted archer attacks an unmounted giant: Cavalry advantage applies despite its size, subject to other disadvantage.
Two Cavalry passengers do not give a horse+20Speed; no flying Speed appears on a walking-only mount.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt the bounded proposal with the completed EX58 controller/phase/physical-history interface; no future transport dependency or extra animal turn.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Add +2 to an actual Persuasion check conducted through diplomacy, negotiation or mediation of a stated agreement, dispute or exchange. NEW: formal describes an acknowledged purposeful exchange with an identifiable request and stakes, not a requirement for court clothing or an official office. The affected party must receive and understand the argument through a legal direct or interpreted channel. Use the social procedure's actual eligibility, DC, stakes, evidence, cost and retry rule. The feat supplies no automatic discount, consent, altered reputation, loyalty, treaty enforcement or permission to ask an impossible favor. A Deception lie, Intimidation threat or unrelated Performance does not receive this Persuasion bonus merely because it occurs in a negotiation. Clothing and other modifiers retain their actual separate qualifications and the shared proposed stacking rule.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Spend ten active minutes closely inspecting one actual item with adequate sensory access and tools appropriate to safely examine it. NEW: make Intelligence (Investigation), DC10 for a plainly identifiable mundane object,15 for complex mundane construction,20 for an ordinary magical item, or25 for a unique unfamiliar construction; a specific item's explicit identification DC or concealment exception controls instead. Set the classification and actual information before rolling. On Success or Critical Success, learn its exact current reference value and complete discoverable operative properties, including magical properties and a curse unless that curse's specific source prevents this identification. Reference value means the recorded undamaged catalog price adjusted by the governing condition/valuation rule, or a Director-established local fair-market valuation when no catalog price exists, fixed before the roll. It is not a guaranteed purchase or sale offer. The property result states uses, limits, charges, activation and known operational risks from the actual item's complete record; it does not invent a missing profile, formula, historical truth or cosmology. A source explicitly resisting identification may withhold its protected part while other properties are identified. Safe appraisal is not activation or disarming; actual independent touch/proximity triggers remain. Failure spends time and yields no exact appraisal; another attempt needs changed evidence, access or method. This deliberately preserves a powerful item-identification benefit and requires direct comparison with Identify before adoption.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Time, DC tiers, value definition, magic/curse scope and explicit identification exceptions. Restricting any source's 'any item' promise requires the stated joint decision.

FS-03.title: Distinct feat bonuses and retained comparison families
FS-03.wording:
NEW joint convention: after eligibility, flat numeric bonuses from DISTINCT feat identities add unless an explicit shared comparison family says otherwise. One feat identity contributes once to the same event/statistic across duplicate representations, sources and owners. This replaces Extended Magic's blanket strongest-same-stat proposal and the conflicting individual statements/examples named in the correction register. It does not rewrite the eight reviewed feats or reviewed maximum-HP components.
Class techniques still perform their own strongest-class-bonus comparison; spells perform their reviewed same-stat comparison; item, attire, tool, facility, cover and item-enhancement contributions retain their own reviewed families. Then add the independently legal feat contribution. A feat-created weapon/armor enhancement explicitly put into an equipment family remains there, not also a feat bonus. Same named condition penalties retain their own comparison rather than becoming additive because a feat created them. Advantage/disadvantage still cancel normally; more sources of advantage do not outvote one disadvantage. Damage resistance of the same scope applies once; immunity retains priority; keep the greatest remaining temporary HP, not their sum. Expanded critical ranges use the broadest applicable range rather than adding chance points. Copies cannot exploit a new family name to duplicate a source. Actual unusual source overrides retain their explicitly narrower predicates.

FS-05.title: Roll type, reroll window and targets
FS-05.wording:
KEEP attacks versus AC, binary saves, fixed-DC Core tasks with natural shifts, and opposed totals with unchanged-state ties lost by the initiator. A +10 attack margin is not a critical. Natural 1/20 on attacks retain their attack rules; saves do not acquire task shifts. A failed-save reroll replaces the whole original one- or two-d20 procedure with the same actual modifiers and advantage/disadvantage, before consequences, unless the exact feat instead replaces a named die position. Use the replacement even if worse; a source cannot reroll its own replacement. Lucky and Elven Accuracy keep their separately specified die-position rules. Costs and prior consequences are not rolled back.
KEEP the current class target convention: 'ally' includes the owner unless the source says OTHER, or real geometry/activity inherently requires a different creature. Do not count the same person twice in 'you and an ally', a team, a flanking pair or an assistance role. 'Enemy' requires an actual current opponent, not every creature in range; meaningful-hostility and anti-farm gates apply only where the source/this register binds resource or encounter rewards. Do not add an enemy or anatomy gate to an unrelated ordinary attack merely as a blanket convention. Source perception, actual reach/line of effect, body eligibility and willing/understood channels remain real.

FS-10.title: Actions, command channels, mounts and personal movement
FS-10.wording:
Keep one additional FULL Action per creature/numbered round and the existing prohibition on additional Actions generating another additional Action/Bonus Action/Reaction. A source that explicitly grants a separate later Bonus Action has only its named window. Free attacks are not full Actions and cannot recursively grant other free attacks unless an exact existing exception says so. Ordinary Attack Action, card technique, weapon attack, spell attack and cantrip are not interchangeable labels.
Use one physical creature identity, controller record, movement pool and authoritative phase. All controlled companions retain the governed shared Bonus Action command and one offensive/control companion action per owner/round. A source may command two bodies for nonoffensive actions only where stated; it does not grant two offensive actions. The feat owner must actually send the required audible/visible/mental channel; known language, trained signals, Silence and source range matter. Existing Tinker devices use actual reviewed channels and shared budgets.
A bonded animal may be a mount only if its actual body, training, size, seat, tack, load and access meet EX58. It does not gain a second phase for being both companion and mount. Register the applicable EX58 mounted-control phase before operation; do not switch schemas midround to obtain unused budgets. Unmounted feat companions use the explicitly supplied after-owner-regular-turn phase. Mount and rider remain separate targets and actor budgets. Cavalry adds10 to each ACTUAL existing mount locomotion Speed while legally ridden, before applicable burden, terrain and later multipliers; it creates no mode, carrying capacity or engine. Route pace uses the actual resulting limiting profile under EX58, not a second free journey. The rider's being carried is not personal walking, Dragoon Momentum or a movement-cost discount. Mount/dismount uses the actual half-current-walk movement cost, access, one-per-regular-interval allowance and fitting seat; an extra Action does not reset it.

FS-13.title: Appraisal, bargaining, social outcomes and settlement
FS-13.wording:
ADOPT Appraise's explicit NEW ten-active-minute item identification/appraisal, separate from the current Action-range Identify spell. It can discover actual unprotected operative magical properties and curses as specified in its exact row; it is not a Divination spell by name and does not infer history, secret identities or cosmology. Source-specific identification protections still apply. Use the row's10/15/20/25 standalone DC fallback only where no actual controlling task/item DC exists. Within Haven's appraisal operation use its actual source/task DC (explicit or tier12/13/15/16/18/19), retain the FULL30-minute lot/item procedure, and count the holder's ten-minute inspection as a real nonoverlapping subtask inside it when the same person/work actually satisfies both. No second roll is created by the label.
A ten-minute bargaining feat likewise occupies only its real subtask of the full30-minute Haven disposition; record the remainder for inspection, agreement and transfer. It does not halve those30minutes or remove provenance, hearing, claims, settlement, sponsor/tax/assay or worker shifts. Standalone transactions can use their own actual procedure without inventing compulsory Haven fees. Predeclare the attainable concession, DC, price basis and costs; on success honor the promised outcome, not a newly imposed 'costly agreement' after the roll. No check compels impossible terms, an absent seller or a player belief. Standing remains EX58 -3..+3 with signed per-scene award bounded±2; aliases and background initialization never erase earned history.
Reference value, actual offer, sale gross and net receipts remain separate. Use exact rational currency until the final purchase-ceiling/sale-floor copper rounding. Apply a named discount once to its agreed eligible basis, never to taxes or paid fees by association. Keep the actual greater-of assay rule and sponsor deductions from EX58-EDIT-02; no10% fine cap is revived. Known properties do not mint stock, title, formula knowledge, free service, wages or a guaranteed buyer.

FS-15.title: Hard denial, reactive awards and physical hazards
FS-15.wording:
Keep the reviewed source-character/target/encounter hard whole-Action/turn-denial guard for these newly authored feat control procedures; a new feat spelling or trap body does not create a second allowance. Explicit Haste voluntary ending-cost exceptions and other already-reviewed exact exceptions retain their own scope.
